brief:
今日全球经济的主线是 AI 热潮遭遇"信任裂缝"：FT 中文网报道，为美国大型数据中心融资的债券已跌入压力区，投资者对 AI 营收能否支撑巨额债务失去信心，AI 发债人正面临"达尔文时刻"。与此同时，美国 9 月通胀率跃升至 3.7%（自 5 月以来首次上升），伊朗战争推高燃料价格，给临近中期选举的美国选民增压。央行层面，欧洲央行行长 Lagarde 在泰国 IMF 会议上强调财政可持续性对经济稳定的关键作用，日本央行行长植田和男则称中东局势、AI 需求与汇率将影响政策时机。新兴市场亦活跃：越南设定 2027 年 GDP 至少增长 10% 的目标，印尼因 MSCI 下调警告开出约 1.17 亿美元罚单，印度信实的 Jio 启动 32 亿美元 IPO。整体而言，AI 融资的可持续性与全球通胀反弹，是今日市场最需要紧盯的两大变量。

**Top 5**
1. 数据中心债券遭抛售、AI 发债人面对"达尔文时刻"——投资者质疑 AI 营收能否支撑巨额债务。https://www.ftchinese.com/story/001111120
2. 9 月美国通胀率跃升至 3.7%——自 5 月首次上升，燃料价格反弹推高选民压力。https://www.ftchinese.com/story/001111108
3. 苹果诉 OpenAI 窃取商业机密案首次举行听证会——硅谷重磅诉讼进入实质性公开听证阶段。https://www.ftchinese.com/story/001111109
4. Lagarde 强调财政可持续性对经济稳定的关键作用——在泰国 IMF 会议上向各国财长喊话。https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-17/lagarde-says-fiscal-sustainability-key-for-economic-stability
5. 越南设定 2027 年 GDP 至少增长 10% 的目标——总理在议会演讲中公布经济目标。https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-17/vietnam-prime-minister-targets-2027-gdp-growth-of-at-least-10

items.title: Lagarde Says Sustainable Finances Key for Economic Stability
items.summary: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde stressed the importance of sound public finances when she addressed ministers in charge of budgets from around the world in Thailand.

items.title: Japan’s Takaichi to Attend APEC in China if Parliament Allows
items.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said she plans to attend the APEC leaders summit hosted by China if parliament permits, confirming her willingness to visit amid a deep freeze of ties between the two Asian economies.

items.title: Fairfax’s Watsa Bets On IDBI Payoff As India Booms, Report Says
items.summary: Canadian billionaire Prem Watsa is betting that his Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd.’s acquisition of IDBI Bank Ltd. will pay off given India’s growth prospects, the Economic Times reported.

items.title: India Halts Sugar Diversion to Ethanol After El Nino Hurts Crops
items.summary: India has ordered state-owned fuel retailers to stop procuring ethanol made from sugar and key sugarcane-based feedstocks in move that may help keep a lid on prices of the sweetener.

items.title: China Encourages Cinemas to Add Sports Events and Lottery Sales
items.summary: China is encouraging cinemas to screen major sporting events, host sports activities and sell sports lottery tickets as part of a drive to link moviegoing with sports consumption, according to a notice from the National Film Administration and General Administration of Sport.

items.title: Indonesia Unveils $117 Million in Fines After MSCI Warning
items.summary: Indonesia announced about $117 million in fines tied to manipulative market practices involving three companies, hours after global index provider MSCI Inc. said it was weighing a downgrade of the country’s stock market over investability concerns.

items.title: Vietnam Prime Minister Targets 2027 GDP Growth of at Least 10%
items.summary: Vietnam’s Prime Minister Le Minh Hung projected gross domestic product will expand at least 10% next year as he outlined the nation’s economic targets in a speech to parliament.

items.title: India’s ‘Cockroach’ Protest Leader Faces Court in Voter-List Row
items.summary: The founder of India’s “Cockroach” protest movement is due to appear in court Saturday after being taken into police custody as a widening fight over the country’s voter rolls keeps New Delhi on edge.

items.title: Jio’s $3.2 Billion IPO Tests Ambani Appeal With Young Indians
items.summary: For generations of Indians, Reliance Industries Ltd. was their introduction to the stock market. Founder Dhirubhai Ambani drew middle-income savers into shares, building a following that endured for decades.

items.title: US Gives Green Light for New Routes from Mexico City Airports
items.summary: The US will allow Mexican airlines to offer new flights into the country from Mexico City’s two biggest airports, lifting restrictions that had blocked additional routes.

items.title: Iran Is Giving Houthis Targeting and Intelligence for Attacks on Saudi Arabia
items.summary: Tehran’s support is helping the Yemeni group mount its most potent attacks yet on the kingdom.

items.title: Ukraine Hurries to Build Defenses Against Russia’s Jet-Powered Drones
items.summary: Kyiv lacks an answer, for now, to Moscow’s mass-produced new weapons.

items.title: Brazen Russian Attacks Are Testing NATO
items.summary: The alliance is facing a dilemma over how to respond without escalating or looking weak.

items.title: How Trump’s Pressure Could Actually End Up Saving Canada
items.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney is using the moment to push through nation-building projects that could kick-start Canada’s economy.

items.title: Hezbollah Tells the Lebanese Government It Wants Its Explosives Back
items.summary: The demand sets  up a public contest of wills with a government that has pledged to demilitarize the Iran-backed militant group.

items.title: Bank of Japan Must Ensure Underlying Inflation Doesn’t Go Above 2%, Ueda Says
items.summary: The central bank’s governor said the Middle East situation, AI demand and foreign-exchange rates would affect the timing of the decision.

items.summary: The company is digging in on its plans to lay off as many as 500 workers at its Stelco operations as the government weighs legal options to protect workers.

items.title: IEA：全球柴油价格还将上涨
items.summary: 国际能源署警告，未来几周欧洲、非洲和拉美的柴油价格可能再次上涨，全球柴油短缺将持续至明年年中，且有赖于中东恢复供应。
